scales.name: Bilawal
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: All shuddh (natural) swaras; corresponds to the Western major scale / Ionian. The reference thaat of Bhatkhande's ten-thaat classification.

scales.name: Khamaj
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: Bilawal with komal (flat) Ni; corresponds to Mixolydian.

scales.name: Kafi
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: Khamaj with komal Ga added; corresponds to Dorian.

scales.name: Asavari
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: Kafi with komal Dha added; corresponds to Aeolian (natural minor).

scales.name: Bhairavi
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: Asavari with komal Re added, so Re, Ga, Dha and Ni are all komal; corresponds to Phrygian.

scales.name: Bhairav
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: Komal Re and komal Dha, all else shuddh; corresponds to the Western double-harmonic-family scale with a natural third.

scales.name: Kalyan
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: Bilawal with tivra (sharp) Ma in place of shuddh Ma; corresponds to Lydian.

scales.name: Marwa
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: Komal Re and tivra Ma, all else shuddh.

scales.name: Poorvi
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: Komal Re, tivra Ma and komal Dha.

scales.name: Todi
scales.source: Jairazbhoy, N.A. (1971). The Rags of North Indian Music: Their Structure and Evolution. London: Faber & Faber.
scales.description: Komal Re, komal Ga, tivra Ma and komal Dha - the most heavily altered thaat, notating with a double-flat-equivalent chain of accidentals.
